summary: Onboarding kiosk flow: temporary service-account, cross-region device pickup, and shipment approval policy question
summary_long: New hire starts Mon 2026-03-15. Hardware shipped to regional depot; HR requests automated kiosk enrollment that creates a temporary, timeboxed service account for initial cluster access. SCIM group mapping failed on duplicate alias; need guidance on approval flow for cross-region shipments and whether temporary service-account approvals require Security sign-off.
description:
Issue summary: HR scheduled an on-site orientation for a new ML engineer starting 2026-03-15. Device (MacBook Pro) was sent to our SF regional depot to be picked up via the 'onboarding kiosk' process. The kiosk is expected to provision the laptop, register asset ID with MDM, and trigger SCIM group sync to Okta to assign engineering groups.

Impact: New hire won't have access to internal dev clusters or corp VPN at orientation without kiosk provisioning. This blocks first-day productivity and scheduled onboarding work. Attendance at orientation booked by HR; rescheduling will be costly.

Environment: Production Okta SCIM connector, SF depot onboarding kiosk (kiosk-03), MDM autopilot, k8s clusters in us-west-1.

Desired outcome: 1) Get the kiosk flow working so asset pickup + first-login provisions the expected groups and issues a timeboxed service-account for initial cluster access (48h window) 2) Clarify policy: who can approve cross-region device shipments and whether Security must pre-approve temporary service-account creation for new hires in the Dedicated team.
steps_to_reproduce: HR opens hardware shipment to regional depot and creates pickup order in Asset Portal with candidate email alias
Depot staff mark package as arrived and candidate uses kiosk-03 to scan pickup QR
Kiosk calls MDM enrollment API, which triggers SCIM sync to Okta to map groups based on corporate email

Observe: SCIM mapping returns 'ambiguous_alias' error and kiosk fails to create user groups; kiosk attempts fallback to creating a timeboxed local service-account but is blocked by IAM policy requiring Security approval
logs: 2026-03-09T14:22:11Z kiosk-03 INFO Received pickup request for alias: j.doe+ml@candidate.example.com
2026-03-09T14:22:13Z scim-sync ERROR mapping error: duplicate_alias_found (matched 2 identities for email j.doe@redwood.local)
2026-03-09T14:22:13Z kiosk-03 WARN group assignment failed; attempting fallback service-account creation
investigation_notes: Checked SCIM audit logs: alias j.doe appears twice (j.doe@redwood.local and j.doe+contractor@redwood.local) due to legacy contractor record not fully deprovisioned (see INT-314159 for contractor residuals)
Depot staff confirm hardware delivered to SF depot on 2026-03-08; asset tag 8271-BL was scanned by kiosk-03
MDM enrollment succeeded (device enrolled, asset tag attached) but group assignment step is blocked by SCIM ambiguity
IAM policy 'temp_account_requires_approval' enforces explicit Security or HR sign-off for any auto-created service-account with cluster privileges; current kiosk flow has no built-in approval path
Spoke with SRE (Anisa) — suggested temporary manual approval via gate ticketing workflow to unblock first-day access while long-term fix is implemented
comments: Priya Shah (2026-03-10): Filing because candidate starts 2026-03-15. HR is asking whether we can expedite kiosk provisioning or provide a loaner with pre-provisioned credentials.
Marco Alvarez (2026-03-10): Assigned. I'll attempt manual approval to create a timeboxed service account for the candidate; need Security to OK the exception. Paging Security and SRE.
Security (SAMLTeam) (2026-03-11): We require documented manager approval and a compensating control (short TTL + audit log). Will review the request if HR attaches manager sign-off email.

Anisa (SRE) (2026-03-11): Manual workaround: create temporary kube rolebinding tied to a short-lived service account and rotate credentials post-onboarding. Need ticket reference number for audit (see linked_issues).
HR (2026-03-11): Manager (T. Nguyen) provided approval in email thread; forwarding to support. Candidate will attend orientation on 2026-03-15 at 09:30 PST.
resolution: Workaround applied: SRE created a manual, timeboxed service-account with a 48-hour TTL and rolebinding to the onboarding namespace. Security approved after receiving manager sign-off email. Asset provisioning completed by kiosk-03 after MDM re-triggered with canonical email mapping.
follow_up_actions: Engineering: Add automated approval webhook in kiosk flow to allow manager-signed approval tokens to be consumed by kiosk (owner: Marco). Due date: 2026-04-02
IAM/Security: Review and publish clear checklist for temporary service-account exceptions and define the required manager approvals and TTL defaults. (owner: SAMLTeam). Due date: 2026-03-20
People Ops: Clean up legacy contractor identities causing SCIM ambiguity (owner: HRIT). Create a runbook to verify aliases before shipment. Due date: 2026-03-22

Depot Ops: Add an in-kiosk step to surface ambiguous alias warnings to depot staff and provide a fallback manual-approval button that opens the gate ticket workflow. (owner: DepotOps). Due date: 2026-04-06
notes: This ticket covers both an operational unblock (manual temp account) and a policy clarification request (who approves cross-region shipments and temporary service-account creation). Keep Security and HR in the loop for compliance/audit purposes.
